translation.name: Biblica® Wɔnhia ɛho kwamma nwoma Asante Twi Nkwa Asɛm

content: Yeinom ne nsɛm a Ɔsɛnkafoɔ, ɔhene Dawid babarima a ɔyɛ ɔhene wɔ Yerusalem seɛ:

content.text: Ɛdeɛn na onipa nya firi nʼadwumayɛ nyinaa mu?
Deɛn na ɔnya firi deɛ enti ɔkum ne ho yɛ no awia so no?
na ɛyɛ ntɛm kɔ deɛ ɛpue firiiɛ hɔ.
na ɛsane bɔ fa ne kwan so.
Nsubɔntene nyinaa tene kɔgu ɛpo mu,
Baabi a nsubɔntene no firie no
a ɛboro deɛ obi bɛka soɔ.
na aso nso ntie nsɛm mma ɛmmu so da.
adeɛ foforɔ biara nni owia yi ase.
Biribi wɔ hɔ a wɔbɛtumi aka wɔ ho sɛ:
Ɛwɔ hɔ dada firi tete nteredee;
ɛwɔ hɔ ansa na wɔwoo yɛn.
na wɔn a wɔnnya nnwoo wɔn no nso
wɔn a wɔbɛdi wɔn akyi no

content: Me, Ɔsɛnkafoɔ, na meyɛ Israelhene wɔ Yerusalem.
Metuu me ho sii hɔ sɛ mede nimdeɛ bɛsua ayɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ biribiara a wɔyɛ no owia yi ase ho. Adesoa duruduru bɛn na Onyankopɔn de ato adasamma soɔ yi!
Mahunu biribiara a wɔyɛ no owia yi ase; ne nyinaa nka hwee, ɛte sɛ deɛ obi de mmirika taa mframa.

content.text: na deɛ ɛnni hɔ no, wɔntumi nkan.

content: Mekaa wɔ me ho sɛ, “Hwɛ, manyini na manya nimdeɛ bebree asene obiara a watena Yerusalem ahennwa so ansa na merebɛdi adeɛ. Manya nhunumu ne nimdeɛ mu osuahunu.”
Afei, meyɛɛ mʼadwene sɛ mɛhwehwɛ na mate nimdeɛ ase, ɛne abɔdamsɛm ne nkwaseasɛm. Nanso mehunuu sɛ yei nso te sɛ deɛ obi di mmirika taa mframa.

content.text: Nimdeɛ bebree de awerɛhoɔ na ɛba;
nyansa bebree de ahohiahia bebree ba.
